body:
Worker trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-10-30 03:07Z, my own slip on w-3af0 R5, GREEN test-94ee1bf0). My Mac scripts checked the load gate (load1 ≤ 4) and the disk gate (≥ 60 GB free on ~) only at script start, so the GREEN leg started at load1 7.81.
Fable2 #4212: check the gate before EVERY leg. A refused leg waits or reports; it never starts over the limit.
The fix: .tmp/mac-gate.sh defines `macgate`. It waits up to GATE_WAIT_S seconds (default 900); otherwise it prints GATE_REFUSED and returns 1. Every Mac launcher function begins `RUNC() { macgate || return 97; /usr/bin/caffeinate … }`, and each script sources "$HOME/GitHub/Personal/TermAl-runner/.tmp/inputs/mac-gate.sh".
Every NEW Mac script must source it and gate every launcher call, including a full gate's single leg. Multi-leg runs also eat disk: each worktree's target/ is about 4 GB, so remove finished worktrees (after copying their evidence) before landing gates.
